shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'pwd && cat ../ticket.md && if [ -f ../round-brief.md ]; then cat ../round-brief.md; fi && cat .lore/dod.md'
/bin/zsh -lc 'cat AGENTS.md && cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts && cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs && cat jest.config.js'
/bin/zsh -lc "rg 'specs/.+#' src/orchestration -n | head -25 && cat tsconfig.json && head -35 CHANGELOG.md && ls node_modules/ajv/package.json"
/bin/zsh -lc "rg 'specs/["'^ ]*#[0-9]'"' | head -20; cat node_modules/ajv/package.json | head -20; rg 'inputSchema' src/types/ai.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts'
s=open(p).read().replace(\"import type {ToolDefinition}\",\"import {Ajv} from 'ajv';\\nimport type {ToolDefinition}\")
s=s.replace('  private readonly tools = new Map<string, StoredTool>();','  private readonly tools = new Map<string, StoredTool>();\\n  private readonly validator = new Ajv({strict: false, validateFormats: false});')
s=s.replace('    this.tools.set(resolved.name, {definitionSource: definition, execute});',\"    if (typeof definition "'!== '"'function') {\\n      try {\\n        this.validator.compile(resolved.inputSchema);\\n      } catch (error) {\\n        throw new Error("'`Invalid input schema for tool ${resolved.name}`, {cause: error});'"\\n      }\\n    }\\n    this.tools.set(resolved.name, {definitionSource: definition, execute});\")
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='package.json';s=open(p).read().replace('\"version\": \"0.3.0\"','\"version\": \"0.4.0\"',1);open(p,'w').write(s)
p='package-lock.json';s=open(p).read().replace('\"version\": \"0.3.0\"','\"version\": \"0.4.0\"',2);open(p,'w').write(s)
p='CHANGELOG.md';s=open(p).read().replace('## [Unreleased]\\n','## [Unreleased]\\n\\n### Changed\\n\\n- Static tool input schemas are checked when registered; invalid schemas now fail immediately with the tool name.\\n',1);open(p,'w').write(s)
p='.lore/dod.md';s=open(p).read().replace('- [ ] Add "'`ajv` to `dependencies`'"','- [x] Add "'`ajv` to `dependencies`'"').replace('- [ ] Compile static "'`ToolDefinition.inputSchema` at `ToolRegistry.register` time (throwing an error naming the tool on invalid schemas) and cache compiled validators for function-valued `ToolDefinitionSource` schemas by schema object reference (`WeakMap`).'"','- [x] Compile static "'`ToolDefinition.inputSchema` at `ToolRegistry.register` time, throwing an error naming the tool on invalid schemas.'"\\n- [ ] Reuse static compiled validators and cache function-valued "'`ToolDefinitionSource` schemas by schema object reference (`WeakMap`).'"');open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
 timeout 300 npm test -- --runTestsByPath src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts --runInBand"

/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts package.json package-lock.json CHANGELOG.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --stat && git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md && git status --short'

/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m 'feat(tools): compile static input schemas' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git status --short --branch"
